speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh, Research Lab is more than a game. Like the slogan says, the physics is theoretical, but the fun is real. Great role. Now you can demolish your Soviet-style cyclotron and build the Large Hadron Collider.

speaker: Penny
text: Wow, Sheldon, I cannot believe you made up your own game. Alright, five. One, two, three, four, five. Oh, wow, look at that. An Department of Defense research grant is renewed.

speaker: Penny
text: Yay!

speaker: Sheldon
text: You're a natural at this, Penny. And as the first beta testers, you two have quite the edge when we play with Wallace and Goofer Polly on Sunday.

speaker: Leonard
text: We must not be playing it right. Oh, jeez, Sheldon, why can't we play on Sunday? Because of the reasons that Penny will now tell you, Penny.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Why not?

speaker: Penny
text: Actually, I have to pick up my friend Justin from the airport.

speaker: Leonard
text: There you go. She has to pick up her friend Justin at the airport, and I can't play because I'm going with her, right?

speaker: Penny
text: Um, yeah, if you want. I mean, there may not be room. We've got a lot of stuff, like guitars and amplifiers.

speaker: Leonard
text: Wait, what are you talking about?

speaker: Penny
text: My friend Justin.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Pay attention, Leonard. That's why she can't play on Sunday.

speaker: Leonard
text: Who is this Justin? No, you didn't.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Your turn, Leonard. Roll the dice, Leonard.

speaker: Penny
text: I told you about him. Yeah, my friend from Omaha plays the guitar. Anyways, coming to LA looking for some session work, so I told him he could just crash on my couch for a few weeks.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Come on, Leonard, if you roll a six, Penny dies horribly in a nuclear meltdown. See what I mean when I say the fun is real?

speaker: Leonard
text: Hang on, some guy is gonna be sleeping on your couch?

speaker: Penny
text: He's not some guy, he's my friend.

speaker: Leonard
text: So, by friend, do you mean friend-friend, gay friend, or ex-boyfriend who you're not platonic with but still might have a thing for you friend?

speaker: Penny
text: Well, he's definitely not gay.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, definitely not gay musician sleeping on my girlfriend's couch. Yippee.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, we went out a little bit a long time ago, but we were never, like, going out.

speaker: Leonard
text: Okay, not to be pedantic, but the last I checked, went out was, in fact, the past tense of going out, which I think we all know is a popular euphemism for saw each other naked.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'll just roll for you.

speaker: Penny
text: You have a problem with Justin staying with me?

speaker: Leonard
text: What was your first clue?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Uh-oh, industrial accident.

speaker: Penny
text: You know what? Don't talk to me like I'm an idiot.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm not talking to you like you're an idiot. I'm saying the whole idea is idiotic.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You accidentally stare at a helium argon laser, lose one turn, and a retina.

speaker: Penny
text: How is that not talking to me like I'm an idiot? It's my friend, it's my couch, and it's my freaking life.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's also your role.

speaker: Leonard
text: You know what? It is your life. If you want to have some stupid guitarist stay on your couch, fine. So, why don't you just rent some bunk beds and invite the Black Eyed Peas?

speaker: Penny
text: Hey, if I want to invite the entire lineup of Lollapalooza to sleep in my apartment, I will, and it's none of your business.

speaker: Leonard
text: Are you listening to yourself? Do you know how childish you sound right now?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, now I'm a child? Well, at least I'm not an idiot anymore.

speaker: Leonard
text: The two aren't mutually exclusive.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, you are such a, what the hell is he doing?

speaker: Leonard
text: Drowning us out. He doesn't like fighting.

speaker: Penny
text: Sheldon, just shut up. Look, the fight is over. Oh, and FYI, you never even heard of the Black Eyed Peas until you met me.

speaker: Leonard
text: I've heard of them. Didn't know they were a band. Sheldon, she's gone. You can turn off the blender.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Has your relationship reached its inevitable ugly end?

speaker: Leonard
text: No, we just had a little spat.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Look on the bright side. As a result of Penny's forfeit, you have become the world's first winner of Research Lab. Would you like a commemorative snow cone?
